whole_copy.source_release_guard: whole_copy_complete plus all target qualifications and retirement/sync/invalidation/ordering

phased.source_release_guard: All exact source readers and old obligations retired; all source-frontier seals, revoke/sync/invalidation/ordering completed

targeted_drain.source_release_guard: Independent driver target-scope program with same genuine-reader/frontier obligations; applicable drain/commit guarantee proved

paired_logical_cost.metric: Difference of the same charged public primitive work and same successful protocol action families under the frozen contract; logical comparison only
paired_logical_cost.condition: Root must accept actual candidate versus independent ordinary control integration on real values/generations/obligations. This subtask does not import or execute candidate.
paired_logical_cost.conditional_operation_counts: Already completed synchronization/order facts can skip their request action in both policies; repeated wait/poll calls are not measured CPU cost

whole_copy_vs_phased.qualitative_difference: Whole-copy source release waits for destination completion; phase may ACK while disjoint destination W/B continues

persistent_mapping.if_same_requirement_enforced: Charge identical authorization revoke/cache/invalidation/ordering; same-owner legal persistent reuse is a weaker contract

actual_new_checks.classification: untimed independent ordinary controls; no old validator/build replay

limitations: Snapshot booleans are paid primitive results, not implementation evidence or new information free to either side.
No minimum additional hardware area is derived; fields may be reused only when full ownership proof permits it.
Current native CQ PR/PW TODO and driver precise-scope omissions are standard baseline maintenance gaps, not independent LR1 innovation.
Intel page/domain drain guarantee is real but bounded; no statement that it supplies DMA whole-page R receipt, unprocessed-request seal or universal zero collateral delay.
Protocol equality does not establish equality of native adapters, host scheduling, placement, timing, area or application outcome.
